summary: Hardened `/tmp` and `/dev/shm` with `nosuid,nodev,noexec`. Both are persistent tmpfs mounts and recovered correctly after reboot.
actions_performed: Verified noexec and nodev behavior directly.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified system health, mount options, permissions, and configuration after reboot.

evidence.requirement: `/tmp` ignores execution, setuid bits, and device nodes and persists across reboot
evidence.summary: Persistent fstab entry uses `nosuid,nodev,noexec`; post-reboot mount retains all options and mode 1777. Execution and device-node probes were denied.

evidence.requirement: `/dev/shm` ignores execution, setuid bits, and device nodes and persists across reboot
evidence.summary: Persistent fstab entry uses `nosuid,nodev,noexec`; post-reboot mount retains all options and mode 1777. Execution and device-node probes were denied.

Healthy baseline boot ID was `646e5f74-dc0e-45e7-9746-226c4351af28`; reboot was acknowledged; recovered boot ID changed to `e15cbded-4881-4b31-8026-5f3d0542a539`. The system returned to running state with local filesystems active and both hardened mounts operational.
